title: Montréal
description: Winter streets and buildings in Montréal, Québec.

photos.title: Red façade
photos.alt: An ornate stone façade washed in red light above lit shop windows and a glowing street lamp
photos.description: Arched windows glow red over a street of parked cars, with a single lamp burning in front.

photos.title: Brick and snow
photos.alt: A red brick and sandstone building facing a snow-covered square with two picnic tables
photos.description: A patterned brick front stands squarely across fresh snow, taller towers rising behind it.

photos.title: Clock tower corner
photos.alt: A stone corner building with bay windows and a clock tower, in muted sepia tones
photos.description: Looking up at a corner building whose clock tower tops a stack of carved bays.

photos.title: Icy street
photos.alt: A narrow icy street between stone and brick buildings, lit by lanterns and street lamps
photos.description: Slush and ice lead the eye down a lamplit street, parked cars lining one side.

photos.title: Downtown avenue
photos.alt: A downtown avenue of lit high-rise towers and bare trees, with car tail lights below
photos.description: Lit windows glow on both sides of the avenue under a deep teal sky.

photos.title: Lit building
photos.alt: A large stone building lit warmly behind bare trees and snow-covered ground under a deep blue sky
photos.description: Street lamps and lit windows glow across a wet road lined with banked snow.

photos.title: Fire escape
photos.alt: A black and white view of a brick building with a zigzag fire escape behind no-parking signs
photos.description: A street lamp flares at the end of the lane, where two figures stand in the dark.
